incoming.name: Marginated Tortoise
incoming.excerpt: In captivity, the primary foodstuffs are dandelions, clover, salad leaves such as rocket or watercress, and also leaves from bean, radish, and crowfoot plants.

incoming.name: Seed
incoming.excerpt: Some exalbuminous seeds are bean, pea, oak, walnut, squash, sunflower, and radish.
